meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Vietnam merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: General Statistics Office of Viet Nam (GSO) institutional core
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / National Statistics Office
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, trade and multi-domain socio-economic statistics. Organised vertically from central to provincial and district levels.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Vietnamese statistical system.

reports.title: Population and housing census / mid-year population estimates
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office
reports.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population reached approximately 102.3 million in 2025, ranking third in Southeast Asia. Provides the demographic base for all per-capita and planning indicators; fertility now below replacement.
reports._notes: Core demographic node. Population ~102.3 million (2025).

reports.title: National Accounts of Viet Nam (GDP)
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office
reports.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for a rapidly industrialising, export-oriented economy.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office
reports.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates by major commodity group. High-frequency price signal used in monetary policy and welfare analysis.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency price node.
_referenced_by: State Bank of Vietnam monetary policy

reports.title: Labour force and employment statistics
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office
reports.description: Labour-force participation, employment, unemployment and related indicators from household and enterprise surveys. Captures the large manufacturing and services workforce that underpins export performance.
reports._notes: Primary labour-market statistical product.

reports.title: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) institutional and reporting core
reports.publisher: State Bank of Vietnam
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, financial stability, external accounts and key macro-financial statistics. Publishes monetary, banking and external-sector data.
reports._notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to GSO.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.publisher: State Bank of Vietnam / GSO related
reports.description: Quarterly and annual BOP statistics. Captures the large goods-trade surplus (especially with the United States) and FDI inflows that characterise Vietnam’s external position.
reports._notes: External-accounts node with strong goods-export surplus signature.

reports.title: Vietnam–United States merchandise trade statistics
reports.publisher: GSO / customs / derived bilateral compilations
reports.description: Bilateral goods trade with the United States. The US is Vietnam’s largest single export market; key categories include electronics/telephones, computers, furniture, apparel and footwear. Trade volumes have expanded rapidly over the past decade.
reports._notes: High-centrality bilateral trade node. USA is the dominant export destination.

reports.title: Vietnam–United States Comprehensive Strategic Partnership framing
reports.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and the United States
reports.description: Political and economic relationship framework elevated to Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. Continuously referenced in trade, investment, security and people-to-people cooperation analysis.
reports._notes: Key bilateral political-economic frame that underpins the large trade relationship.
_referenced_by: Security and South China Sea discussions

reports.title: Vietnam foundational statistical-system and USA-linkage meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO, SBV and bilateral sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the GSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, labour statistics, SBV institutional role, BOP, Vietnam–US merchandise trade and Comprehensive Strategic Partnership framing into the opening foundation layer.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node for Vietnamese research, with explicit USA trade and partnership edges.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: National seaport cargo and container throughput statistics
reports.publisher: Vietnam Maritime Administration / Ministry of Construction related
reports.description: Official statistics on total cargo throughput (million tonnes) and container throughput (TEUs) across Vietnam’s seaport system. Recent years show strong growth, with container volumes exceeding 30 million TEUs and cargo approaching or exceeding 900–960 million tonnes.
reports._notes: Core national maritime-logistics statistical product.

reports.title: Ho Chi Minh City / Cai Mep port complex operational statistics
reports.publisher: Port authorities / maritime administration
reports.region: Southeast / Ho Chi Minh City area
reports.description: Operational statistics for the southern gateway complex (Ho Chi Minh City Port / Cat Lai and the deep-water Cai Mep–Thi Vai cluster). Together they form Vietnam’s largest container handling concentration and rank among the world’s top container ports by volume and performance.
reports._notes: Primary southern international-gateway port node.
_referenced_by: HCMC GRDP and Southeast regional analysis

reports.title: Hai Phong port operational statistics
reports.publisher: Port authorities / maritime administration
reports.description: Operational statistics for Hai Phong — the principal northern gateway port. Ranks among the world’s top container ports by volume and has recorded strong performance-index gains.
reports._notes: Primary northern international-gateway port node.
_referenced_by: Red River Delta and industrial-province analysis

reports.title: National logistics and multimodal connectivity framing
reports.publisher: Derived from maritime, transport and planning sources
reports.description: Policy and analytical framing of Vietnam’s logistics system — seaports, inland connectivity, and the role of logistics in supporting manufacturing exports and FDI. Continuously referenced in trade-facilitation and competitiveness discussions.
reports._notes: System-level logistics framing node.
_referenced_by: Seaport throughput and major port nodes

reports.title: Vietnam ports–logistics densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from maritime administration and port sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding national seaport cargo and container throughput, Ho Chi Minh City / Cai Mep port complex, Hai Phong port, and national logistics framing into a coherent maritime-logistics layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the ports densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Trade, FDI, regional and industrial series from earlier batches

reports.title: Ethnic minority population and composition statistics
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / related
reports.description: Official statistics on Vietnam’s 54 ethnic groups. The Kinh majority forms the large bulk of the population; ethnic minorities (approximately 15 % of the total) are concentrated especially in the Midlands and Northern Mountains and the Central Highlands.
reports._notes: Core demographic node for ethnic composition.

reports.title: Midlands and Northern Mountains regional profile
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO regional and poverty sources
reports.description: System-level view of the Midlands and Northern Mountains — the region with the highest concentration of ethnic minorities and persistently higher poverty rates. Accounts for a disproportionate share of national poverty relative to its population.
reports._notes: Key lagging-region spatial node that contrasts with the Red River Delta and Southeast growth poles.
_referenced_by: National accounts and regional disparity analysis

reports.title: Ethnic minority poverty and living-standards statistics
reports.publisher: GSO / World Bank-aligned and national poverty monitoring
reports.description: Poverty rates and living-standards indicators disaggregated by ethnicity. Ethnic minorities account for a large majority of remaining poverty despite representing a minority of the population; absolute numbers of poor ethnic minorities have fallen substantially over the past decade.
reports._notes: Core equity / residual-poverty densification.

reports.title: Ethnic minority and mountainous-region development policy framing
reports.publisher: Party-State / Ministry of Ethnic and Religious Affairs related
reports.description: National policy framing and target programmes for socio-economic development in ethnic minority and mountainous regions (including the National Target Programme 2021–2030). Continuously cited in poverty-reduction and regional-equity discussions.
reports._notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the ethnic and regional statistical nodes.
_referenced_by: Ethnic poverty and Northern Mountains nodes

reports.title: Vietnam ethnic–northern-mountains densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO, poverty and ethnic-policy sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding ethnic minority population and composition, Midlands and Northern Mountains regional profile, ethnic minority poverty statistics, and ethnic-policy / mountainous-region development framing into a coherent equity and lagging-region layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the ethnic and northern-mountains densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier poverty, regional and social-protection series

reports.title: Digital economy value-added and share of GDP
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / National Statistics Office
reports.description: Official measurement of the digital economy’s contribution to GDP. In 2025 the digital economy reached an estimated 14.02 % of GDP (approximately USD 72 billion), up substantially from earlier in the decade. Distinguishes core digital sectors from the digitalisation of other industries.
reports._notes: Core digital-economy statistical product. High-centrality modernisation node.

reports.title: E-commerce and digital trade component of the digital economy
reports.publisher: GSO / related
reports.description: E-commerce and digitally enabled wholesale/retail activity as a measurable component of the digital economy. Accounts for a significant share of digital-economy value added and generates rising tax revenues.
reports._notes: E-commerce densification within the digital-economy cluster.

reports.title: National Digital Transformation Strategy framing
reports.publisher: Government of Vietnam / related
reports.description: Official National Digital Transformation Strategy (including the 2026–2030 strategy with vision to 2045). Sets targets for digital government, digital economy (ambitious share of GDP) and digital society, and organises policy action across ministries.
reports._notes: High-level policy frame for the digital agenda.

reports.title: Vietnam digital-economy densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO and digital-strategy sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding digital-economy value-added and GDP share, e-commerce component, and National Digital Transformation Strategy framing into a coherent digital-modernisation layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the digital densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, services and strategy series from earlier batches

reports.title: Da Nang Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / local statistical office
reports.description: Official GRDP for Da Nang — the principal urban and services/tourism hub of the Central region. Regularly ranks among the mid-to-upper tier of provincial economies and contributes meaningfully to national growth.
reports._notes: Primary Central urban-core regional output node.

reports.title: Can Tho Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / local statistical office
reports.description: Official GRDP for Can Tho — the largest city and commercial hub of the Mekong Delta. Complements the broader Mekong Delta agricultural and aquaculture profile with an urban services and logistics node.
reports._notes: Primary Mekong Delta urban-core regional output node.

reports.title: Central Highlands regional economic profile
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO regional and provincial series
reports.description: System-level view of the Central Highlands — a major coffee, pepper and agricultural region with significant ethnic-minority populations and distinct development challenges and opportunities relative to the coastal and delta growth poles.
reports._notes: Central Highlands spatial densification that links agriculture, ethnicity and lagging-region dynamics.

reports.title: Selected secondary provincial economies (Quang Ninh, Thanh Hoa, Nghe An, etc.)
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO GRDP series
reports.description: Grouping of secondary but still material provincial economies outside the top industrial and dual-core set — including Quang Ninh, Thanh Hoa, Nghe An and similar mid-tier contributors that collectively add meaningful shares of national growth and diversify the spatial structure.
reports._notes: Secondary provincial densification that softens the exclusive focus on the top five growth poles.

reports.title: Vietnam further-provincial densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO provincial GRDP sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Da Nang GRDP, Can Tho GRDP, Central Highlands regional profile, and selected secondary provincial economies into a coherent further-provincial densification layer that complements the earlier Hanoi, HCMC, Red River Delta, industrial-province and Mekong Delta nodes.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the further provincial densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier regional, industrial and agricultural series

reports.title: Index of Industrial Production (IIP)
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / National Statistics Office
reports.description: Monthly and cumulative Index of Industrial Production covering manufacturing, mining, electricity and water. Manufacturing dominates growth; electronics and related processing are major drivers.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency industrial activity node.

reports.title: Foreign Direct Investment statistics (registered and disbursed)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Planning and Investment / GSO related
reports.description: Official FDI attraction figures (new projects, additional capital, capital contributions). Processing and manufacturing typically absorb the large majority of inflows. Singapore, Korea, China, Japan and others lead recent rankings; US FDI stock and flows remain strategically important.
reports._notes: High-centrality investment node. Manufacturing absorbs ~2/3 of recent FDI.

reports.title: FDI by major partner country / territory
reports.publisher: MPI / GSO related
reports.description: Breakdown of FDI inflows by source. Singapore, South Korea, China, Japan, Hong Kong and others dominate recent flows; US FDI is smaller in annual ranking but significant in stock, technology and strategic sectors.
reports._notes: Partner-side densification of the FDI cluster. Complements the large USA export relationship.

reports.title: Rice production statistics
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / Ministry of Agriculture related
reports.description: Official volume and area statistics for rice (paddy). Vietnam remains one of the world’s top rice exporters; the Mekong Delta is the primary production basin.
reports._notes: Foundational food-security and export-crop node.

reports.title: Agriculture, forestry and fishery production statistics
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office
reports.description: Broader primary-sector output covering crops, livestock, forestry and fisheries/aquaculture. Complements the rice-focused series.
reports._notes: Core primary-sector production node.

reports.title: Hanoi Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / local statistical office
reports.description: Official GRDP for the capital city. Major services, administration and industrial contributor to national growth.
reports._notes: Primary northern urban-core regional output node.

reports.title: Ho Chi Minh City Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / local statistical office
reports.description: Official GRDP for Ho Chi Minh City — Vietnam’s largest urban economy and southern commercial/industrial hub. Together with Hanoi forms the dual-core national economic structure.
reports._notes: Primary southern urban-core regional output node.

reports.title: Red River Delta regional economic profile
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO GRDP and industrial series
reports.description: System-level view of the Red River Delta — the northern industrial and growth engine that includes Hanoi, Hai Phong, Bac Ninh and other high-performing provinces. Frequently the largest contributor to national growth.
reports._notes: Northern growth-pole spatial node.

reports.title: Key industrial provinces (Bac Ninh, Hai Phong, Dong Nai, etc.)
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO GRDP and IIP series
reports.description: High-growth industrial provinces that drive electronics, manufacturing and port-related activity. Bac Ninh, Hai Phong, Dong Nai and similar localities often post double-digit GRDP growth and large contributions to national industry.
reports._notes: Provincial industrial densification that links FDI, electronics and regional growth.
_referenced_by: Red River Delta and Southeast regional nodes

reports.title: Vietnam industry–FDI–agriculture–regional densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO, MPI and related sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Index of Industrial Production, FDI statistics and partner breakdown, rice and broader agriculture production, Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City GRDP, Red River Delta profile and key industrial provinces into a coherent industry–investment–spatial layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 2 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
BOP, USA trade and national accounts from Batch 1

reports.title: Electronics, computers and components trade statistics
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / customs related
reports.description: Trade statistics for electronics, computers and components — the single largest and fastest-growing export category. Exports have more than tripled over the past decade; imports of components remain large, reflecting assembly-oriented participation in global value chains. Dominant in the Vietnam–US trade corridor.
reports._notes: High-centrality commodity node linking industry, FDI and the USA export relationship.

reports.title: Electricity generation and energy mix statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Industry and Trade / EVN / GSO related
reports.description: Power generation and capacity by source. Coal remains a large share of total energy supply; hydropower, gas, solar and wind are expanding under successive Power Development Plans. Energy transition targets are progressively raising renewable shares.
reports._notes: Core energy-system node. Coal-heavy with rising renewables.
_referenced_by: National accounts and industrial energy demand

reports.title: National Power Development Plan (PDP) framework
reports.publisher: Government of Vietnam / Ministry of Industry and Trade
reports.description: The successive National Power Development Plans (including PDP8 and adjustments) that set capacity targets, fuel mix trajectories and energy-transition pathways to 2030 and beyond.
reports._notes: High-level energy planning frame node.

reports.title: Poverty and living standards survey statistics
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office
reports.description: Results from the Vietnam Household Living Standards Survey and related poverty-rate series. Multidimensional and income poverty have fallen sharply; remaining poverty is concentrated in northern mountainous and some ethnic-minority areas.
reports._notes: Core welfare measurement node.

reports.title: Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) participation
reports.publisher: Government of Vietnam / related
reports.description: Vietnam’s membership in CPTPP (in force 2019). Provides preferential access to a high-standard Pacific trade bloc and interacts with electronics, apparel and agricultural export patterns.
reports._notes: Major high-standard plurilateral FTA node.

reports.title: EU–Vietnam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA)
reports.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and the European Union
reports.description: Bilateral FTA with the European Union (in force 2020). Significant for apparel, footwear, agricultural and other exports to the EU market.
reports._notes: Key European market-access node.

reports.title: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) participation
reports.publisher: ASEAN + partners / Vietnam
reports.description: Vietnam’s membership in RCEP. Links ASEAN with China, Japan, Korea, Australia and New Zealand and reinforces regional electronics and intermediate-goods value chains.
reports._notes: Major regional mega-FTA node.

reports.title: Vietnam FTA / EPA network overview
reports.publisher: Derived from trade-policy sources
reports.description: System-level view of Vietnam’s extensive FTA network (ASEAN, CPTPP, EVFTA, RCEP, bilateral agreements with Japan, Korea, etc.). Organises the individual treaty nodes and underpins export diversification.
reports._notes: High-level trade-architecture organising node.

reports.title: Vietnam electronics–energy–poverty–FTA densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO, energy and trade-policy sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding electronics/computer trade, energy mix and Power Development Plan, poverty/living-standards statistics, CPTPP, EVFTA, RCEP and overall FTA network into a coherent value-chain, energy, welfare and trade-architecture layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 3 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
USA trade, IIP, FDI and national accounts from earlier batches

reports.title: Mekong Delta regional economic and agricultural profile
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO and agricultural sources
reports.description: System-level view of the Mekong Delta — Vietnam’s primary rice bowl and major aquaculture region. Produces the majority of national rice, a large share of fruit and fisheries output; faces climate and salinity challenges.
reports._notes: Southern agricultural heartland spatial node. Complements the northern industrial Red River Delta.

reports.title: Aquaculture and fisheries production statistics
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / Ministry of Agriculture related
reports.description: Official volume and value statistics for aquaculture and capture fisheries. Vietnam is a major global seafood exporter; the Mekong Delta dominates production.
reports._notes: Core aquaculture/fisheries statistical product.

reports.title: International visitor arrivals and tourism statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism / GSO related
reports.description: Official statistics on international tourist arrivals, source markets and related tourism indicators. Arrivals have recovered strongly and set new records in recent years.
reports._notes: Core tourism statistical product.

reports.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) and climate-policy framework
reports.publisher: Government of Vietnam / related
reports.description: Vietnam’s NDC under the Paris Agreement and associated climate-policy framing. Continuously referenced in energy, agriculture, forestry and adaptation discussions.
reports._notes: Core climate-policy frame node.
_referenced_by: Energy mix and Power Development Plan

reports.title: Greenhouse gas emissions inventory and statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment / related
reports.description: National GHG inventory results by sector (energy dominant, followed by agriculture and industrial processes). Provides the empirical base for NDC tracking.
reports._notes: Emissions-side climate node.

reports.title: Health insurance coverage statistics
reports.publisher: Vietnam Social Security / related
reports.description: Official coverage rates for the national health insurance scheme. Coverage has reached very high levels (above 90 % of the population in recent years).
reports._notes: Core health-financing / social-protection coverage node.

reports.title: Social insurance and unemployment insurance coverage
reports.publisher: Vietnam Social Security
reports.description: Coverage statistics for compulsory social insurance and unemployment insurance among the labour force. Complements health-insurance coverage and forms the core of the formal social-security system.
reports._notes: Core social-insurance coverage node.

reports.title: Vietnam Mekong–tourism–climate–social-protection densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO, tourism, climate and VSS sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Mekong Delta regional profile, aquaculture/fisheries, tourism arrivals, NDC climate framework, GHG inventory, health insurance coverage and social insurance coverage into a coherent southern-spatial, services, climate and social-protection layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 4 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier agriculture, energy, poverty and regional series

reports.title: Vietnam–China merchandise trade statistics
reports.publisher: GSO / customs related
reports.description: Bilateral goods trade with China. China is Vietnam’s largest overall trading partner and dominant import source (intermediate goods, components, machinery). Vietnam runs a large structural trade deficit with China while exporting electronics, agricultural products and other goods.
reports._notes: High-centrality bilateral trade node. China is the largest import source and second export market.

reports.title: Vietnam–China Comprehensive Strategic Partnership framing
reports.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and China
reports.description: Highest-tier bilateral relationship (Comprehensive Strategic Partnership since 2008). Continuously referenced in trade, investment, border management and South China Sea discussions.
reports._notes: Political-economic frame for the largest overall trade relationship.

reports.title: Vietnam–Korea trade and FDI statistics
reports.publisher: GSO / MPI / customs related
reports.description: Bilateral trade and investment with the Republic of Korea. Korea is a top-three export market, major import source and consistently among the largest FDI sources (electronics, manufacturing, consumer industries).
reports._notes: High-centrality Korea corridor node (trade + FDI).

reports.title: Vietnam–Korea Free Trade Agreement (VKFTA)
reports.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and Republic of Korea
reports.description: Bilateral FTA in force since 2015. Deepens preferential access beyond the ASEAN–Korea framework and supports the large bilateral investment and trade relationship.
reports._notes: Key bilateral FTA densification for the Korea corridor.

reports.title: Vietnam–Japan trade and FDI statistics
reports.publisher: GSO / MPI / customs related
reports.description: Bilateral trade and investment with Japan. Japan is a top-five export market, important import source and long-standing major FDI partner (manufacturing, infrastructure, technology).
reports._notes: High-centrality Japan corridor node (trade + FDI).

reports.title: Vietnam–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (VJEPA)
reports.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and Japan
reports.description: Bilateral EPA in force since 2009. Complements the ASEAN–Japan CEP and CPTPP; covers goods, services, investment and movement of natural persons.
reports._notes: Foundational bilateral EPA with Japan.

reports.title: ASEAN economic cooperation framework (Vietnamese participation)
reports.publisher: ASEAN / Vietnam
reports.description: Vietnam’s participation in the ASEAN Economic Community and related ASEAN+ FTAs. Continuously cited in regional trade, investment and production-network analysis.
reports._notes: Core regional-architecture node.

reports.title: UK–Vietnam Free Trade Agreement (UKVFTA)
reports.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and the United Kingdom
reports.description: Bilateral FTA in force since 2021 (continuity agreement after Brexit). Preserves preferential access to the UK market for Vietnamese exports.
reports._notes: Post-Brexit European market-access node.

reports.title: Vietnam multi-vector external economic strategy framing
reports.publisher: Derived from trade, FDI and partnership sources
reports.description: System-level framing of Vietnam’s deliberately multi-aligned external economic posture: largest export market in the United States, largest import and overall trade partner in China, major FDI and technology partners in Korea and Japan, dense preferential access via CPTPP/EVFTA/RCEP, and Comprehensive Strategic Partnerships with 14 countries including all five UN Security Council permanent members.
reports._notes: High-level organising frame for Vietnam’s external economic architecture.
_referenced_by: All major bilateral and FTA nodes

reports.title: Vietnam international-architecture densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GSO, MPI, customs and partnership sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Vietnam–China trade and partnership, Vietnam–Korea trade/FDI and VKFTA, Vietnam–Japan trade/FDI and VJEPA, ASEAN framework, UKVFTA, and multi-vector external strategy framing into a coherent international-architecture layer that complements the USA corridor and existing CPTPP/EVFTA/RCEP nodes.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the international densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
USA trade, CPTPP, EVFTA, RCEP and FDI series from earlier batches

reports.title: China FDI in Vietnam statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Planning and Investment / GSO related
reports.description: Registered and realised FDI from China (and Hong Kong where separately reported). China ranks among the top sources by number of new projects and has risen into the top tier by capital in recent years; manufacturing and processing dominate.
reports._notes: Investment-side densification of the China corridor. Complements the large trade relationship.

reports.title: Vietnam–China trade structure (electronics, intermediates, agriculture)
reports.publisher: Customs / GSO related
reports.description: Commodity composition of bilateral trade. Vietnam imports large volumes of intermediate goods, components and machinery from China; exports electronics, telephones, agricultural products and other goods. Structural deficit with China is a recurring feature.
reports._notes: Commodity-structure densification of the China trade relationship.

reports.title: Vietnam–China Border Economic Zones and cross-border cooperation
reports.publisher: Vietnamese government / provincial sources
reports.description: Border Economic Zones (BEZs) and Cross-Border Economic Cooperation Zones along the Vietnam–China land border (Lao Cai, Mong Cai, Dong Dang, Cao Bang and related pairs). Focus of infrastructure, trade facilitation and local economic development.
reports._notes: Spatial and institutional densification of the land-border economic relationship.

reports.title: Vietnam–China land border treaty and border management framework
reports.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and China
reports.description: Legal and institutional framework stemming from the 1999 Land Border Treaty and subsequent demarcation/management agreements. Provides the foundation for orderly border trade, BEZs and local cooperation.
reports._notes: Foundational legal node for the land border.

reports.title: Vietnam–China Community with a Shared Future framing
reports.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and China
reports.description: Elevated political framing (Community with a shared future that carries strategic significance) that sits above the Comprehensive Strategic Cooperative Partnership. Continuously referenced in joint statements and high-level visits.
reports._notes: Highest-tier political framing densification.
_referenced_by: Trade, FDI and border cooperation analysis

reports.title: Vietnam–China infrastructure and railway connectivity projects
reports.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and China / related
reports.description: Priority cross-border infrastructure cooperation, including standard-gauge railway lines linking the two countries. Treated as strategic connectivity projects in joint statements.
reports._notes: Physical-connectivity densification of the bilateral relationship.
_referenced_by: Border Economic Zones and trade nodes

reports.title: China-linked supply-chain and production-network framing
reports.publisher: Derived from trade, FDI and industrial sources
reports.description: Analytical and policy framing of Vietnam’s position in China-centred and China-linked regional production networks — especially electronics and intermediate goods. Captures both complementarity and strategic diversification pressures.
reports._notes: Value-chain framing node that links China inputs to Vietnam’s export performance (including to the USA).
_referenced_by: Electronics trade and China trade-structure nodes
USA export corridor and multi-vector strategy

reports.title: Vietnam–China deep-dive densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from MPI, customs, border and partnership sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding China FDI, detailed trade structure, Border Economic Zones, land-border treaty/management, Community with a Shared Future framing, infrastructure/railway connectivity, and China-linked supply-chain framing into a coherent deep bilateral layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the China deep-dive pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier China trade, partnership, electronics, FDI and multi-vector series

reports.title: Structure and total assets of credit institutions
reports.publisher: State Bank of Vietnam
reports.description: Official statistics on the structure of the credit-institution system (state-owned commercial banks, joint-stock commercial banks, foreign banks, policy banks, finance companies, people’s credit funds, etc.) and their total assets, charter capital and key ratios.
reports._notes: Core structural node for the Vietnamese banking system.

reports.title: State-owned commercial banks (SOCBs) statistics
reports.publisher: State Bank of Vietnam / related
reports.description: Statistics focused on the major state-owned commercial banks (Vietcombank, VietinBank, BIDV, Agribank and related). These institutions hold a large share of system assets and play a central role in credit allocation.
reports._notes: State-owned banking densification.

reports.title: Credit growth and outstanding loans statistics
reports.publisher: State Bank of Vietnam
reports.description: System-wide and sectoral credit growth rates and outstanding loan volumes. Credit expansion is a key transmission channel of monetary policy and a major driver of investment and consumption.
reports._notes: High-frequency credit-activity node.
_referenced_by: SBV monetary policy and banking-system nodes

reports.title: Non-performing loans and asset-quality statistics
reports.publisher: State Bank of Vietnam / commercial bank disclosures
reports.description: System-wide and bank-level non-performing loan ratios, absolute NPL volumes and loan-loss provisioning / coverage ratios. Key indicator of banking-system health and credit risk.
reports._notes: Core asset-quality / risk node.

reports.title: Monetary aggregates and key SBV monetary indicators
reports.publisher: State Bank of Vietnam
reports.description: Money supply, deposit and other monetary aggregates that complement credit statistics and feed monetary-policy analysis.
reports._notes: Monetary densification of the central-bank cluster.

reports.title: Policy and development banking institutions (VBSP and related)
reports.publisher: Vietnam Bank for Social Policies / SBV related
reports.description: Statistics and institutional role of the Vietnam Bank for Social Policies and other policy-oriented credit institutions that target poverty reduction, rural development and social objectives.
reports._notes: Policy-banking densification linking finance to social objectives.

reports.title: Vietnam banking and financial-system densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from SBV sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the structure and total assets of credit institutions, state-owned commercial banks, credit growth, non-performing loans, monetary aggregates and policy-banking institutions into a coherent banking and financial-system layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the banking densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: State budget revenue and expenditure statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance
reports.description: Official state budget execution reports covering revenue collection, expenditure and overall fiscal balance. Provides the primary fiscal-flow series for the central and local budgets.
reports._notes: Core fiscal-flow node.

reports.title: State budget deficit statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance
reports.description: Official deficit figures for the state budget (central and local components) as a share of GDP and in absolute terms. Closely monitored against National Assembly targets.
reports._notes: Deficit densification of the fiscal cluster.

reports.title: Public debt and government debt statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance / related
reports.description: Official public debt, government debt and external debt ratios relative to GDP, together with related debt-service indicators. Maintained well below statutory ceilings in recent years (public debt typically mid-30s % of GDP).
reports._notes: Core public-debt stock node.

reports.title: Education enrolment and completion statistics
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office / Ministry of Education and Training
reports.description: Net and gross enrolment rates and completion rates by education level (primary, lower secondary, upper secondary). Vietnam has achieved near-universal primary enrolment and high lower-secondary coverage.
reports._notes: Core education access and progression node.

reports.title: Literacy and educational attainment of the population
reports.publisher: General Statistics Office
reports.description: Literacy rates and distribution of the population by highest educational attainment and technical qualifications. Average years of schooling and the share of the adult population with upper-secondary or higher education form key human-capital stock indicators.
reports._notes: Human-capital stock densification.

reports.title: Higher education and technical qualifications statistics
reports.publisher: GSO / MOET related
reports.description: Statistics on tertiary education and the share of the population holding technical or university-level qualifications. Complements basic enrolment and literacy series.
reports._notes: Tertiary / skills densification of the human-capital cluster.

reports.title: Vietnam fiscal–education densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from MOF, GSO and MOET sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding state budget revenue and expenditure, budget deficit, public debt, education enrolment and completion, literacy and educational attainment, and higher-education/technical qualifications into a coherent fiscal and human-capital layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the fiscal and education densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier macro, labour, poverty and social-protection series

reports.title: Defence / military expenditure statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from official budget and international compilations (SIPRI-aligned)
reports.description: Estimates and reported figures for Vietnam’s military expenditure. Recent levels are commonly placed around USD 10 billion and in the low-to-mid 2 % of GDP range. Provides the resource base for force modernisation and self-defence capacity.
reports._notes: Core defence-resource node.

reports.title: National defence policy framing
reports.publisher: Ministry of National Defence / Party-State documents
reports.description: Official national defence policy emphasising peace, self-defence, non-use of force, peaceful settlement of disputes, and gradual modernisation of the Vietnam People’s Army sufficient for self-defence. Continuously cited in security and foreign-policy analysis.
reports._notes: Core policy-frame node for Vietnamese defence posture.

reports.title: National security strategy framing
reports.publisher: Party-State documents (e.g. Central Committee resolutions)
reports.description: High-level national security strategy documents and resolutions that set priorities for internal stability, external defence, and the integration of security with socio-economic development.
reports._notes: Strategic densification above day-to-day defence policy.
_referenced_by: Internal security and social stability analysis

reports.title: Maritime security and East Sea (South China Sea) framing
reports.publisher: Derived from defence, foreign-policy and partnership sources
reports.description: Policy and strategic framing of Vietnam’s maritime security interests, including sovereignty claims and the consistent preference for peaceful negotiation under international law (UNCLOS). Closely linked to the multi-vector external posture.
reports._notes: Maritime-security densification of the defence cluster.
_referenced_by: China partnership and multi-vector strategy nodes

reports.title: Vietnam defence–security densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from MOD, fiscal and strategy sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding defence/military expenditure, national defence policy framing, national security strategy framing, and maritime security / East Sea framing into a coherent defence and security layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the defence densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Fiscal, partnership and multi-vector series from earlier batches

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.
